units.source_text: 就这样，谁也不知道真正的理由，一晃就是七年，

en.t: In this way, with no one knowing the real reason, seven years passed in a flash,

units.source_text: 根据民法第三十条规定，最后那男人家属只得接受了死亡认定。

en.t: and under Article 30 of the Civil Code, the man's family finally had no choice but to accept the declaration of death.
